events.input: LangGraph is a framework for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs.
ReAct combines Reasoning and Acting in LLM agent loops.
Ollama runs open-source language models locally without cloud APIs.
Type hints specify expected data types for parameters and return values.
Async programming uses asyncio and event loops for non-blocking I/O.
AgentPulse is a digital twin-driven runtime security framework for AI agents.
Isolation Forest is an unsupervised machine learning algorithm for anomaly detection.
LLM agents are systems that use LLMs to reason, plan, and invoke tools.
Prompt injection is an attack vector where malicious input overrides model instructions.
AI tool security requires input validation, path traversal defense, and runtime monitoring.
Feature extraction converts runtime event sequences into numerical vectors.
Stratified K-Fold splits data while preserving class proportions across folds.
Random Forest is an ensemble of decision trees trained on random feature subsets.
A confusion matrix reports true positives, false positives, true negatives, and false negatives.
UTC timestamps record event occurrences in coordinated universal time.
